decisions.reason: Its encrypted second-channel communication remains central to the firm's identity and secure messaging platform, even if some functionality may increasingly be bundled rather than marketed alone.

Mobile PDF signing still fits the firm's move into app-based transactions and digital contract processes, though as a feature-level offer it faces some risk of being folded into a broader signing suite.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is a core differentiator for a cryptography-driven German security provider and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
This specific email-to-app delivery tool is the most likely to be retired because it can be absorbed into wider secure communication workflows and is less defensible as a standalone product.

The payment security compliance suite still serves regulated enterprise demand and leverages the firm's authentication infrastructure, although niche compliance products can face portfolio rationalization.
